description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report, including data transformation and data extraction logic.

classes.name: EiaPetroleumStatusReportQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for the EIA Petroleum Status Report, including category, table, and cache options.

classes.name: EiaPetroleumStatusReportData
classes.description: Data model for the EIA Petroleum Status Report data entries.

classes.name: EiaPetroleumStatusReportFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class responsible for retrieving and transforming the petroleum status report data from the EIA website.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input query parameters, validates table choices, and constructs query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads the Excel file containing the report data from the EIA website.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes the downloaded Excel file, extracts relevant data, and returns a list of data model instances.
